page0.text:
Then...
The next thing I know, it's morning.
page0.sourceUnit: セイバールート十四日目-06:page0:1

page1.text:
"Pathetic. I couldn't sleep a wink."
I sigh and turn off the ringing alarm clock.
Today, no matter what she says, Saber and I are going on a date.
My first priority will be to take her to plenty of places, so she'll have a chance to enjoy herself.
I've been trying to search my mind for the perfect spot for a date, but before I could come up with anything, my alarm went off.
page1.sourceUnit: セイバールート十四日目-06:page1:1

page2.text:
"..."
I'd turned the alarm clock on just in case.
As hard as I tried, I still couldn't think of anything last night, so I borrowed an alarm clock from Tohsaka, figuring I might have to pull an all-nighter.
Not that it's done any good.
page2.sourceUnit: セイバールート十四日目-06:page2:1

page3.text:
"Come to think of it, I've never been on a date."
I sigh again.
That's sort of a problem.
I'm nervous enough, plus I didn't sleep, but I think the worst part is how shocked I am that, after staying up all night to think about it, I couldn't come up with a single thing a girl might like.
page3.sourceUnit: セイバールート十四日目-06:page3:1

page4.text: "Fine. I'm going to leave it all to chance. I'm just going to take her all over the place and she'll learn what it's like to have a good time."
page4.sourceUnit: セイバールート十四日目-06:page4:1

page5.text:
I'll just take her to cute shops.
Well, I feel like there's a fundamental flaw in that plan, but I've already made up my mind.
There's nothing else I can think of, but what this all boils down to is that today is going to be a day packed with fun, and it'll go on until Saber says she's had enough.
page5.sourceUnit: セイバールート十四日目-06:page5:1

page6.sourceUnit: セイバールート十四日目-06:page6:1

page7.text:
"No. She's still asleep. It doesn't look like she's going to wake up anytime soon, so you two got lucky there.
If Illya were awake, she would've followed Shirou around and gotten in your way.
page7.sourceUnit: セイバールート十四日目-06:page7:1

page8.text:
"Yes. We cannot have her accompany Shirou like she has been doing.
Things may have taken an unexpected turn last night, but today we shall go and search for the remaining Masters. Shirou does not have time to be taking care of Illyasviel."
page8.sourceUnit: セイバールート十四日目-06:page8:1

page9.text:
"Uh, well I wasn't talking about her getting in the way like that...but oh well.
It's not my place to tell you exactly what you're doing. This is you and Shirou's problem."
Tohsaka laughs mischievously.
page9.sourceUnit: セイバールート十四日目-06:page9:1

page10.text:
"Huh? A problem between Shirou and I?"
...
page10.sourceUnit: セイバールート十四日目-06:page10:1

page11.text:
We finish breakfast, and it seems like a good time to leave.
Saber is ready to look for Masters, but I'm determined to execute my plan as well.
I just need to be a man and tell her.
page11.sourceUnit: セイバールート十四日目-06:page11:1

page12.text:
"About that, Saber...
We're going to go to the neighboring town today. If you have to get ready, I want you to do it now."
page12.sourceUnit: セイバールート十四日目-06:page12:1

page13.text:
"Are we going to go search for Masters? I would suggest we go to the suburbs instead of the neighboring town."
"That's not what we're doing. The two of us are gong to go out and have fun today, so there's no point in us going to the suburbs."
page13.sourceUnit: セイバールート十四日目-06:page13:1

page14.text:
"Huh...?"
Saber freezes.
I try to ignore the sound of Tohsaka trying, and largely failing, to control her laughter behind me. I will get her for that...later.
page14.sourceUnit: セイバールート十四日目-06:page14:1

page15.text:
"Um, Shirou...I do not understand. It is not you and Rin going out to have fun, but..."
"If I'm going, you're the only one who could come with me, Saber. Tohsaka is going to stay back and watch Illya, so she has nothing to do with this."
page15.sourceUnit: セイバールート十四日目-06:page15:1

page16.text: "This is ridiculous. You and I going to the next town to investigate will yield nothing. There is no point to this. What are you trying to accomplish here?"
page16.sourceUnit: セイバールート十四日目-06:page16:1

page17.text:
Saber's pretty clearly frustrated.
I kind of figured something like this would happen, but things are looking even bleaker than I thought since she clearly thinks we're going out to town to search for Masters.
page17.sourceUnit: セイバールート十四日目-06:page17:1

page18.text: "This is rough... I'm being really clear, but you still don't get it, Saber. I'm trying to ask you on a date."
page18.sourceUnit: セイバールート十四日目-06:page18:1

page19.text:
I ignore Tohsaka's stare as I speak to Saber.
I'm not sure how much Saber understands.
"I do not understand what you mean. Can you clarify, Shirou?"
She looks even more irritated.
page19.sourceUnit: セイバールート十四日目-06:page19:1

page20.text:
...
And suddenly, it's like a switch flips in my head.
There's no sense beating around the bush here.
It'd be best if I were just blunt with her.
page20.sourceUnit: セイバールート十四日目-06:page20:1

page21.text:
"Shirou. If you tell me to go to town, then I will obey. However I would appreciate it if you explain what the purpose of this 'date' is.
No matter how familiar I am with this age, there are terms I still do not know. Please do not use technical terms without explaining them."
page21.sourceUnit: セイバールート十四日目-06:page21:1

page22.text:
"It's not really a technical term.
I can teach you if you don't know, but a date is when someone goes out and has fun with a girl."
"Huh...?"
Saber goes completely still.
page22.sourceUnit: セイバールート十四日目-06:page22:1

page23.text:
"A girl... Do you mean...me?"
She's dazed now, muttering.
When I nod yes, Saber looks even more confused.
page23.sourceUnit: セイバールート十四日目-06:page23:1

page24.text: "I understand the meaning of the word now, but I still do not understand your intentions. For what reason would you do such a thing?"
page24.sourceUnit: セイバールート十四日目-06:page24:1

page25.text:
"...Hm."
I wasn't expecting this question.
I mean, I know what the point of a date is, but now that I'm on the spot and Saber wants me to explain it to her face, well...
page25.sourceUnit: セイバールート十四日目-06:page25:1

page26.text: "Argh! She's confused because you're using an unusual term. Drop 'date' and just use a term that's easier to understand."
page26.sourceUnit: セイバールート十四日目-06:page26:1

page27.text:
"Listen, Saber. A date basically means a tryst.
Shirou may be talking about going out and having fun, but what he's really getting at here is the whole 'boy trying to attract the attention of a girl he likes' thing."
page27.sourceUnit: セイバールート十四日目-06:page27:1

page28.text:
"Gh—!?"
I cough, loud.
Tohsaka may be right, but I am pretty confident that a date and a tryst are two very different things.
page28.sourceUnit: セイバールート十四日目-06:page28:1

page29.text:
...
But I don't think it's worth mentioning.
From her reaction, it looks like Saber finally understands what a date is.
page29.sourceUnit: セイバールート十四日目-06:page29:1

page30.text:
"Exactly, Saber.
We're going to head to town and we're not going to fight. We can't fight during the day anyway because there are people around. So there should be no problem with us spending the day however we want."
page30.sourceUnit: セイバールート十四日目-06:page30:1

page31.text: "That may be true, but this seems pointless. I can see nothing that you will gain from doing such a thing."
page31.sourceUnit: セイバールート十四日目-06:page31:1

page32.text:
"That's not entirely true. And I wouldn't mind if it were.
I've decided to spend the day with you, Saber, so don't worry about me.
We're going to go out to town, and that's that. Nothing you say will change my mind, Saber."
I look her straight in the eye.
page32.sourceUnit: セイバールート十四日目-06:page32:1

page33.text:
...
Saber ponders for a while, looking serious.
"Then even if I refuse, will you be heading out to town on your own?"
page33.sourceUnit: セイバールート十四日目-06:page33:1

page34.text:
"Yep, I'm definitely going. Or everything I spent all night thinking about will have been a waste."
"...Then I cannot allow you to go unaccompanied. I am your Servant, and so cannot leave my Master to go alone."
page34.sourceUnit: セイバールート十四日目-06:page34:1

page35.text:
After taking a deep breath...
Saber answers in her usual manner.
page35.sourceUnit: セイバールート十四日目-06:page35:1

page36.text:
...
Okay, that could have gone better, but at least I've managed to convince her to come out.
I shouldn't sweat the small stuff at this point.
page36.sourceUnit: セイバールート十四日目-06:page36:1

page37.text:
"Have fun! Bring back something nice!"
As we step outside, I make a rude gesture at Tohsaka, since she made fun of me until the very end.
page37.sourceUnit: セイバールート十四日目-06:page37:1

page38.text:
"So...
What, specifically, are we going to do, Shirou?"
"Well, let's just head to the neighboring town. We'll catch the bus at the intersection."
page38.sourceUnit: セイバールート十四日目-06:page38:1

page39.text:
The hilly path is unusually quiet.
It's a little past nine in the morning on a weekday, and the town is starting to come alive, but it must be a little early to be heading out somewhere.
There's no one on the road; it's like we have the road to ourselves.
page39.sourceUnit: セイバールート十四日目-06:page39:1

page40.text: "Now that I think about it, I don't feel guilty about skipping school anymore. I've been cooped up in the house these past few days."
page40.sourceUnit: セイバールート十四日目-06:page40:1

page41.text: "Of course. You are a Master, so you should not be walking around so casually."
page41.sourceUnit: セイバールート十四日目-06:page41:1

page42.text:
Saber's tone is sharp.
Saber following behind me is nothing new, but it feels different today.
I feel this immense pressure directed at me, and that's putting it mildly.
I can tell Saber's going to be tough to handle.
page42.sourceUnit: セイバールート十四日目-06:page42:1

page43.text:
We get on the bus.
It would have been stuffed with people about an hour ago, but there's only a handful of people using it now.
The only people on the bus are old women with children, so it feels like we have the place to ourselves.
page43.sourceUnit: セイバールート十四日目-06:page43:1

page44.text:
"Saber, let's sit at the very back."
I call out to Saber, who for some reason tries to sit at the front of the bus, and lead her to the wider seat at the back.
page44.sourceUnit: セイバールート十四日目-06:page44:1

page45.text:
"..."
Saber quietly looks out over the passing scenery.
page45.sourceUnit: セイバールート十四日目-06:page45:1

page46.text:
I steal a glance at her, and realize how crazy I am for what I'm trying to do today.
Taking the bus to a nearby town is an ordinary thing for me.
But here, in this ordinary place, something extraordinary is happening.
page46.sourceUnit: セイバールート十四日目-06:page46:1

page47.text:
Or...
Well, I'm finding myself questioning whether I'm actually doing this whole date thing, and my mind starts spinning and whirling like some complex cube puzzle.
page47.sourceUnit: セイバールート十四日目-06:page47:1

page48.text:
...
Ahhh.
Crap. I'm getting really nervous. It's...kind of getting out of control.
page48.sourceUnit: セイバールート十四日目-06:page48:1

page49.text:
...
I take a deep breath to calm myself down so Saber won't notice.
But then...and I know this is stupid...I take another look at Saber.
page49.sourceUnit: セイバールート十四日目-06:page49:1

page50.text:
"...Gh."
My heart skips a beat.
I hardly recognize Saber as she sits next to me. Or...well, it's less that I don't recognize her than it is that the situation itself is unrecognizable.
It makes me realize that she is something else... She is different.
page50.sourceUnit: セイバールート十四日目-06:page50:1

page51.text:
I didn't realize it when we were at home.
This ordinary, everyday life seems to me like it's become something entirely new and different just because Saber is here.
page51.sourceUnit: セイバールート十四日目-06:page51:1

page52.text:
Her golden blonde hair...her green eyes... Those alone are enough to make her overwhelmingly beautiful.
It hadn't really crossed my mind, since I never had much to compare her to.
page52.sourceUnit: セイバールート十四日目-06:page52:1

page53.text:
I remember the first time I met Saber.
I must have been avoiding her because I was too embarrassed to admit that I was admiring Saber.
No matter what Saber says, to me, she's a girl before she's a swordsman.
I didn't know how to react to her, and I didn't understand my feelings for her.
page53.sourceUnit: セイバールート十四日目-06:page53:1

page54.text:
"..."
I have to admit, I know I sound stupid.
I've developed trust and affection for Saber, past the point of no return. And now I've decided to go on a date with her.
The order of events is all backward. Now, as I get off the buss, I finally realize what a big deal it is to go on a date with the girl I like.
page54.sourceUnit: セイバールート十四日目-06:page54:1

page55.text:
But that's okay.
I can only give it my all, so I can't very well take it all back and cower in fear now.
page55.sourceUnit: セイバールート十四日目-06:page55:1
